meta.title: About | Association Jeunes Actifs
meta.description: Discover the mission, values and vision of Association Jeunes Actifs — a student-led association working on the Oriental region's social and environmental development.

hero.title: About us
hero.text: Association Jeunes Actifs is a social, cultural and environmental association based in Morocco's Oriental region. Founded by higher-education students, it brings together engaged young people who want to contribute to their community through concrete, lasting action.

mission.title: Supporting the commitment of an entire generation
mission.text: Our mission is to support young people across the Oriental in their civic engagement by giving them a framework to act, learn and grow. We design and carry out social, environmental and educational projects that respond to our territory's real needs, while training the next generation of association leaders.

valeurs.title: Our values
valeurs.text: These principles guide every one of our actions and decisions.

engagement.title: Civic engagement
engagement.text: We encourage every young person to take an active part in their community's life.

solidarite.title: Solidarity
solidarite.text: We act together, through mutual support and respect, for collective impact.

culture.title: Culture
culture.text: We celebrate the Oriental's cultural heritage and nurture creativity among young people.

environnement.title: Environment
environnement.text: We build environmental protection into every one of our initiatives.

developpement.title: Youth development
developpement.text: We train and support students so they become agents of change.

vision.title: Our vision
vision.text: We aspire to make the Oriental region a model of engaged youth, where every student finds ways to invest in projects that matter. In the long run, we want to build a strong network of alumni who keep carrying the values of solidarity, culture and environmental care into their professional and personal lives.

meta.description: Social, cultural, environmental action, training and community projects carried out by the association in Morocco's Oriental region.

hero.title: Our activities
hero.text: Association Jeunes Actifs acts on several fronts to support young people across the Oriental and contribute to the region's development. Here's what we do, concretely.

solidarite.description: We carry out action for the Oriental's vulnerable populations through collections, outreach visits and solidarity projects.
solidarite.exemple: Clothing and food collection for families in need during Ramadan.

culture.description: We organize events that celebrate the Oriental's cultural heritage and bring communities closer together.
culture.exemple: A musical evening dedicated to the region's artistic traditions, with local artists.

environnement.description: We run awareness campaigns and concrete action to protect the environment in our region.
environnement.exemple: A clean-up day at Parc Lalla Aïcha in Oujda with 80 student volunteers.

formations.description: We offer hands-on workshops to develop students' leadership, communication and project management skills.
formations.exemple: A 3-day training course on planning and budgeting for association projects.

evenements.description: We create spaces for exchange and connection between higher-education students across the Oriental.
evenements.exemple: The annual forum on association engagement at Mohammed I University in Oujda.

benevolat.description: We encourage and support students' volunteer engagement in projects that make a real impact on the ground.
benevolat.exemple: A regular volunteering program with weekly missions in priority neighborhoods.

projets.description: We design and carry out local development projects in partnership with the region's stakeholders.
projets.exemple: A shared community garden project in a neighborhood of Oujda.
